versions.changelog:
Initial release of cliphi-clips.

- Turn long videos into ready-to-post vertical clips with captions and branding using the Cliphi API.
- Supports videos from YouTube, podcasts, livestreams, and Twitch VODs.
- Finds viral moments in the video and generates free preview links first; charges only apply for rendering finalized clips.
- Strict workflow to ensure user approval before any charges or renders.
- Delivers finished clips and project studio links for further editing and publishing.
